title: Parents Are Stocking up on Bulk Disinfectant From Sam's Club Ahead of Back-To-School - NewsBreak
text: Parade aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission. Back-to-school season often comes right before cold and flu season . That's because of several reasons, including the changing weather and the fact that many people go back to being indoors for the majority of the time. Many people, like teachers, tend to stock up on cleaning and disinfectant supplies during this time to try and keep themselves and their students healthy for as long as they can. But, buying things like Lysol Disinfectant Sprays can get costly, which is why people head to Sam's Club to stock up. The good news for shoppers is that Sam's Club currently has an amazing deal on a multipack of the disinfectant spray, which has people from all professions running into the store to take advantage. Sam's Club members can now get a three pack of Lysol Disinfectant Spray for just $15.98. According to the website, each of the cans is 19 ounces, and can be used on hard and soft surfaces alike. "Lysol Disinfecting Spray helps protect you and your family and helps keep them healthy! Lysol products are designed to provide germ protection and can kill 99.9% of viruses and bacteria on hard surfaces when used as directed," the website says. "When cleaning counters to couches, you can depend on Lysol to kill 99.9 percent of bacteria. This disinfectant spray eliminates odors and kills 99.9 percent of mold and mildew on most household surfaces. It even sanitizes soft surfaces and deodorizes the air. This value pack includes three, 19 oz. Lysol Disinfecting Spray Cans and leaves behind a fresh crisp linen scent with every spray. Protection starts with prevention!" Related: Shoppers Say Sam's Club's Bulk Buy of This Back-to-School Essential Is 'Well-Made' and a 'Great Bargain' Shoppers are huge fans of the Lysol spray and aren't afraid to share their thoughts. In fact, there are over 2,300 reviews of the product, which has a 4.9 out of 5 star rating! "Tried another disinfectant spray and returned to buying Lysol," one shopper wrote. "The other one smelled light and fresh, but was wetter spray, rather than small particles that disbursed into air better, and it took more to freshen the area for shorter time. I also haven't had only rare issues with Lysol can not spraying well, compared to more frequent issues with other brand i tried. So...Lysol spray disinfectant wins and the price, though a bit higher, is decent when Sam's has it on sale." "I use this on a regular basis. Since COVID I make sure I have at least two cans on hand," another person wrote. "I have no immune system and this helps keep germs away. I spray when my husband gets home from shopping or at church to take care of anything he may have brought in. I can't risk it and so far all germs are being eliminated." It's clear that Sam's Club shoppers think this product is worth checking out! Related: Target’s New Back-to-School Must-Have Is So Popular, Over 2,000 People Bought It Last Month
